verdict.rationale: Pigment documents button-driven scenarios for testing different assumptions (pigment-docs-11) and application histories down to the data-block level with full visibility into edit events (pigment-docs-16), plus an Audit Trail API for application events (pigment-docs-13). Together these suggest change tracking that could support auditable scenario comparison, but no source explicitly ties edit history to individual scenarios or their assumptions. missing for 10: explicit per-scenario assumption records, documented attribution of who changed each scenario's assumptions, audit-aware scenario comparison views, independent or hands-on corroboration.
